k: system design rate limit token bucket
a: Token bucket allows bursts while enforcing average rate.
Leaky bucket smooths traffic to a constant drain rate.
Sliding window logs track request timestamps for precise limits.
Sliding window counters approximate rate with less storage.
Distributed locks coordinate exclusive access across nodes.
Fencing tokens prevent stale lock holders from corrupting state.
Coalescing reduces stampedes on shared expensive work.
Stampedes happen when many clients miss cache together.
Early expiration recomputes cache values before hard expiry.
